text:
ria: quick heads-up from today's atlas-int4 canary (streaming + retry budget stress). We're seeing idempotency failures where retries end up executing duplicate tools even though the model output parsed as valid JSON on at least one attempt.

ben: can you share numbers and a short log?

ria: summary (N=1200):
- json-syntactic-pass: 98.6%
- strict-schema-pass: 95.2%
- duplicate-tool-invoke (caused by retry): 1.9%
- cases where parse-success + handler-retry: 1.4%

chao: repro pattern?

ria: simplified trace:
```
handler: received req id=zz-77 attempt=1 invocation-id=null
runtime: stream chunk A -> partial JSON emitted
handler: NDJSON parser error on suffix -> handler triggers retry (backoff)
handler: new attempt=2 generated without carrying invocation-id
runtime: stream chunk B -> emits remainder leading to parseable JSON
runtime: two tool-runs spawned (tr-123, tr-124)
```

chao: so two logical attempts and we executed both. Root causes appear to be (1) missing invocation-id propagation on older SDKs and (2) our retry policy retried on parse/NDJSON errors that may be recoverable via streamer merge.

ben: short-term mitigations?

chao: proposed playbook:
1) server-side: require and honor X-Invocation-Id when present; de-dupe duplicate invocation-ids at proxy for 10s and return 409 for repeated attempt with same id.
2) handler: do not auto-retry on NDJSON parse errors if invocation-id present (fail-fast) to avoid double side-effects.
3) sanitizer: add canary-flagged NDJSON joiner that attempts safe fixes (strip trailing comma, insert newline between objects) but logs raw+fixed payload and increments sanitized_ndjson metric.
4) sdk: follow-up to always emit X-Invocation-Id (next week).

ria: I pushed a proxy hotfix that stores seen ids in a small LRU memcache ttl=10s and returns 409 for duplicates. Canary-bot: routing 1% to proxy-hotfix branch.

canary-bot: post-patch snapshot (N=500): duplicate-tool-invoke down to 0.3%, parse-success-with-retry down to 0.2%, sanitized_ndjson events=12.

ben: good. But sanitizer must be opt-in per-route; don't want to mask model contract drift. Also add an alert if sanitized_ndjson_rate > 0.5% on prod.

chao: agreed. I'm adding an eval that fuzzes chunk boundaries and forces immediate retries to ensure proxy de-dupe holds. Also adding telemetry for invocation_id_coverage by sdk_version.

ria: one more observation: many remaining failures correlate with KV-cache resume during streaming. Plan to run a kv-resume-disabled canary to isolate.

ci-bot: scheduled extended canary: atlas-int4 kv-resume disabled + proxy-dedupe enabled, 24h at 5% starting 1812345700.

ben: rollout plan: keep proxy dedupe in front of canary; if 24h at 5% shows duplicate_tool_invoke <0.5% and strict-schema-pass >=97% we promote; otherwise rollback. SDK patch to emit invocation id follows.

ria: PRs: proxy dedupe merged to canary branch, sanitizer behind flag, eval fuzz tests added. Will post links.

chao: logging note: include invocation-id and attempt-id in downstream tool logs and structured-output telemetry so we can trace de-dupe hits to actual tool-run-ids.

ben: nice. Thanks team — ping here when the 24h starts and when the SDK patch lands. :thumbsup:
